propositions: rebar comment and related commands silently accept flag-looking tokens (e.g. --body-file, --body) as the positional body argument instead of rejecting them, causing the intended content to be discarded while exit code remains 0
a command invoked as `rebar comment <id> --body-file <path>` stores the literal string '--body-file' as the comment body and discards the path, with no stderr or non-zero exit to signal the loss
positional-body commands drop surplus arguments via args[:min_args] slicing, compounding the silent loss when a flag token is mistaken for the body
the silent failure defeats the documented instruction that agents must write findings back as durable ticket comments, causing downstream gates to make correct decisions on missing evidence

the fix must reject any positional body beginning with - unless explicitly escaped with --, and the guard must apply uniformly across all positional-body commands to prevent the footgun from recurring
